Color Harmony Generator

Build complementary, analogous, triadic, tetradic and split-complementary palettes from any base color using real HSL math.

Computed with real HSL hue rotation. Click any swatch to copy its HEX.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a base color.
  2. Five harmony rules generate instantly: complementary, analogous, triadic, tetradic, split-complementary.
  3. Click any swatch to copy its HEX code.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is a color harmony?

A set of colors spaced by fixed angles on the color wheel (hue circle). Harmonies look balanced because the spacing follows geometric rules.

How are the palettes computed?

Your color is converted to HSL, the hue is rotated by the rule angle (e.g. +180° for complementary), then converted back to HEX. Saturation and lightness are preserved.

Which harmony should I use?

Complementary for bold contrast, analogous for calm cohesion, triadic/tetradic for vibrant variety, split-complementary for strong-but-safe contrast.
